title: Personal Metrics Playbook — Ida Martin
content:
Quick personal playbook for tracking goals, experiments, and small rituals. This is a scratchpad: messy, half-formed ideas, TODOs, and weekly micro-retros. Use as the single source for my weekly one-minute check-ins and quarterly planning drafts.

Context (who I am and why this exists):
- role: senior software engineer, infra/serving-runtime focus. Trying to balance shipping product improvements with fewer context switches and better async comms.
- goal: have a compact, repeatable cadence to measure impact (not just activity).

Quarterly objectives (Q1 draft) — top 3:
1) Reduce median tail latency for dev-serving tests by 12% (measured on canary infra).
   - key results (draft):
     - KR1: Identify top 3 hot paths in serving runtime and land micro-optimizations (3 PRs).
     - KR2: Add a lightweight end-to-end benchmark to CI that captures median and 95p.
     - KR3: Get two customer-facing regression alerts set up in console so SREs are aware.
2) Improve feature delivery predictability for infra stories.
   - KR1: Drop mid-sprint scope churn from ~30% -> <10% via better scoping docs.
   - KR2: Pilot a lightweight spec template and use it for 4 stories.
3) Personal craft: write 2 technical notes on kernel selection and quantization tradeoffs; present one internally.

Weekly check-in template (copy weekly):
- Week of: ____
- Top priority this week (1):
- Secondary focus (2):
- Measured signal to track this week (metrics + where to find them):
  - e.g., canary-median-latency: dashboard /observability/infra/canary (note: dashboard link in Confluence page CONFLUENCE-9876)
- Blockers / unknowns: what I need from others (names/threads):
- Quick retro from last week (2 lines): what went well / what to stop doing:

Weekly quick example (2026-02-16):
- Top priority: benchmark harness for variable sequence lengths (PR in progress).
- Signal: median latency + variance on small-batch synthetic -> observed 8% improvement in micro-optimizations branch.
- Blocker: need infra quota increase for canary rig (pinged Tom Nguyen, JIRA-ENG-4123).
- Retro: good: smaller PRs landed faster. bad: late context-switch for oncall. Action: move oncall notes into short checklist and add to morning ritual.

Habit and cadence checklist (daily / weekly rituals):
- Daily (15 min): open dashboard -> scan median/95p for active canaries; note anomalies to slack-thread.
- Daily (10 min): triage one code review.
- Weekly (30–45 min): write/update spec for next story (use template).
- Biweekly: demos with SRE/product for feedback.

Retrospective notes (running):
- 2026-01-30 retro (post-spike):
  - Decision: shift prioritization to small wins that improve CI visibility rather than large unproven refactors.
  - Action items: add bench job to CI pipeline; write short doc on how to interpret the bench numbers. Owner: Ida (ETA 2026-02-10, shipped).
- 2025-12-15 retro (holiday sprint):
  - Learned: context windows shrink during holidays -> prefer fewer concurrent stories.
  - Idea: keep a lightweight backlog 'holiday-safe' with single-owner stories.

Experiment log (short entries, keep 1–2 lines per experiment):
- exp-2026-02-05: enabled LRU cache on KV layer for small prefixes -> +6% median, +12% 95p; further testing needed at higher conc.
- exp-2026-01-12: tried different batching timeouts (25ms vs 50ms) -> 50ms gives slightly better throughput but increases p95; revert to 25ms for latency-sensitive routes.

Open questions (to explore):
- How to most clearly attribute latency improvements to changes vs workload variance? (need a short doc on attribution methodology).
- Can we automate small spec validation with a checklist bot? (talk to devexp / Tom)

Notes-to-self / shorthand ideas:
- Keep notes short in PRs: TL;DR + perf impact (numbers) + canary dashboard link.
- When writing the 'bench interpretation' doc: include toy examples showing noisy vs signal.
- If quota issues persist, escalate with a small deck for infra capacity owners.

Action items (current):
- [ ] Finalize bench harness PR and attach results to CONFLUENCE-9876 (due 2026-02-24).
- [ ] Create spec template and run it for next two stories (due 2026-03-01).
- [ ] Draft the attribution methodology doc (first pass 1 page).

Random brain dump (scratch):
- Could add a daily micro-reflection line to calendar: 5 min to record A: one win, B: one improvement. Helps retrospectives later.
- Consider pairing with Priya on the canary alerts to ensure we tune thresholds properly.
- Keep PR names clear: feature/bench/<short-desc>

End of playbook. This file is iterative — expect a lot of small edits, TODO ticks, and raw fragments. Use as my canonical weekly scratch note and archive snapshots before major changes.
